competitions.name: UEFA Champions League
competitions.clubs_note: competition proper; 81 teams total from 53 associations
competitions.qualification: Places by UEFA association coefficient: associations 1-5 four teams, 6 three, 7-15 two, 16-55 one (Russia suspended, Liechtenstein has no league). Champions League and Europa League holders get an extra berth if not already qualified through their league. Two European Performance Spots go to the two associations with the best previous-season coefficient. Qualifying is split into Champions Path and League Path over Q1-Q3 plus a play-off round: 28 champions in Q1, 24+4 in Q2, 12+8 in Q3, 10+4 in the play-off; 7 play-off winners join the 29 direct entrants in the 36-team league phase.

phases.label: Final
phases.quote: Final ... 5 June 2027 at the Metropolitano Stadium, Madrid

competitions.league_phase_shape: Single 36-team table, 8 matches per club, four home and four away, against eight different opponents. Four pots by club coefficient; each club plays two clubs from each pot, one home and one away. Not a round-robin and not a dynamically re-paired Swiss system: it is one fixed pot-drawn partial league. Top 8 to R16, 9th-24th to the knockout play-offs, 25th-36th eliminated.
competitions.quote: Each team will play eight matches, four at home and four away, against eight different opponents, with all 36 teams ranked in a single league table. Teams were separated into four pots based on their 2026 UEFA club coefficients, and each team will play two teams from each of the four pots - one at home and one away.

competitions.name: UEFA Europa League
competitions.clubs_note: competition proper (25 direct + 11 transferred); 76 teams total from 41 associations
competitions.qualification: Cup winners and league places by association coefficient: associations 1-12 two teams, 13-33 one, plus the Conference League title holder. Champions Path and Main Path over Q1-Q3 and a play-off round; losers of the Champions League qualifying and play-off rounds drop in (Q2/Q3/play-off). 12 play-off winners join the 24 direct entrants in the league phase.
competitions.league_phase_shape: Single 36-team table, 8 matches per club against eight different opponents, pot-drawn like the Champions League (same UEFA league-phase regulations). Top 8 to R16, 9th-24th to the knockout play-offs.
competitions.quote: League phase (36 teams) ... Knockout phase play-offs (16 teams) ... Round of 16 (16 teams)

competitions.name: UEFA Conference League
competitions.clubs_note: competition proper (24 direct + 12 transferred); 111+54 teams total from 54 associations
competitions.qualification: Third tier: the widest access list in Europe — 11 cup winners from associations 45-55, 21 runners-up from 34-55 and 20 third-placed teams from 30-50 enter Q1; Q2 and Q3 add more league places plus teams dropping out of the Champions League and Europa League. 24 play-off winners (5 Champions Path, 19 League Path) plus 12 Europa League play-off losers make the 36-team league phase.

phases.label: Final
phases.quote: Final ... 2 June 2027 at Besiktas Stadium, Istanbul

competitions.league_phase_shape: Single 36-team table, 6 matches per club over 6 matchdays, pot-drawn (same UEFA league-phase template as UCL/UEL, shorter). 36 clubs over 6 rounds cannot be a round-robin, so it is a partial pot-drawn league. Top 8 to R16, 9th-24th to the knockout play-offs.
competitions.quote: A total of 36 teams are competing in the league phase to decide the 24 places in the knockout phase of the 2026-27 UEFA Conference League.

competitions.name: CONMEBOL Libertadores
competitions.clubs_note: 47 teams from 10 associations: 28 direct to group stage, 13 to second stage, 6 to first stage
competitions.qualification: Brazil 7 berths, Argentina 6, all other associations 4 each, plus the Libertadores and Sudamericana holders. Group stage gets the holders, berths 1-5 of Argentina and Brazil and berths 1-2 of everyone else (28 clubs); second stage gets Brazil 6-7, Argentina 6, Chile and Colombia 3-4, everyone else's berth 3 (13 clubs); first stage gets berth 4 of Bolivia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela (6 clubs). Berths are league positions and cup winners per association (e.g. Brazil: cup winner + Serie A places; Argentina: Apertura, Clausura, Copa Argentina, aggregate table).

phases.label: Final
phases.quote: Final ... 28 November 2026 at Estadio Centenario, Montevideo

competitions.quote: The winners and runners-up of each of the eight groups in the group stage advanced to the round of 16.

competitions.name: CONMEBOL Sudamericana
competitions.clubs_note: 44 direct + 12 transferred from the Libertadores; 44 from 10 associations
competitions.qualification: Argentina and Brazil 6 berths each, all other associations 4 each, awarded to the best league-placed clubs not already in the Libertadores (plus domestic cup winners where the association's rules say so). Argentina and Brazil enter the group stage (12 clubs); the other 32 enter a single-leg first stage. Four Libertadores third-stage losers drop into the group stage and the eight third-placed Libertadores group teams drop into the knockout play-offs.

phases.label: Final
phases.quote: Final ... 21 November 2026 at Estadio Metropolitano Roberto Melendez, Barranquilla

competitions.quote: The following are the four losers of the third stage of the Copa Libertadores which joined the 12 direct entrants and the 16 Copa Sudamericana first stage winners in the group stage.

competitions.name: AFC Champions League Elite
competitions.clubs_note: competition proper; 36 teams total from 14 associations (first season with 32 in the league stage)
competitions.qualification: Slots by AFC club competitions ranking, split into West and East regions of 16 clubs each: Saudi Arabia 4+1, UAE 3+1, Qatar 3, Iran 2, Uzbekistan 1+1, Iraq 1, Jordan 0+1 (West); Japan 4+1, South Korea 3+1, Thailand 3, China 2, Australia 1+1, Malaysia 1, Vietnam 0+1 (East). One preliminary matchday (11 August 2026) fills the last four league-stage places.
competitions.league_phase_shape: Two separate 16-team regional tables (West, East), 8 matches per club over 8 matchdays. Clubs are seeded into four pots per region and, per the AFC draw grid, 'each club will play two matches against the clubs from each pot' in adjacent columns - i.e. 8 different opponents out of 15, not a round-robin and not a re-paired Swiss. Top 8 of each region reach the Round of 16, which is regional; QF, SF and final are single-leg in a centralised host country.
competitions.quote: For each region, teams will be seeded into four pots and each club will play two matches against the clubs from each pot.

competitions.name: AFC Champions League Two
competitions.clubs_note: competition proper; 35 teams total from 24 associations
competitions.qualification: Second tier, slots by AFC club competitions ranking, split West/East. Domestic league places and cup winners of the mid-ranked associations enter the group stage directly; lower-ranked entrants play a single-leg preliminary stage (12 August West, 31 August East) for the remaining places. The winner qualifies for the next ACL Elite preliminary stage.
competitions.quote: The tournament features 32 teams in the group stage.

competitions.name: CAF Champions League
competitions.clubs_note: 64 registered in the infobox; the Teams section says CAF initially confirmed 61 teams from 48 associations
competitions.qualification: Champions of every CAF member association; the top 12 associations in the CAF 5-year ranking enter two teams (champion and runner-up). Two two-legged qualifying rounds (first round, second round) reduce the field to 16 for the group stage; teams eliminated in the second round drop into the CAF Confederation Cup play-off round.

phases.label: Final
phases.quote: Final ... 9-31 May 2027 (exact dates to be confirmed)

competitions.quote: The winners of the competition will automatically qualify for the 2027-28 CAF Champions League

competitions.name: CAF Confederation Cup
competitions.qualification: Second tier: the top 12 associations in the CAF 5-year ranking enter two teams (typically third place in the league and the cup winner or cup runner-up), all other associations one (mostly cup winners, some league runners-up and federation entrants). Teams eliminated from the CAF Champions League second round drop into the Confederation Cup second round. Two two-legged qualifying rounds lead to a 16-team group stage.

phases.label: Final
phases.quote: Final ... 9-31 May 2027 (exact dates to be confirmed)

competitions.quote: The following 56 teams from 44 associations entered the competition.

competitions.name: CONCACAF Champions Cup
competitions.clubs_note: 27 teams from 10 associations; 5 byes to the round of 16, 22 in round one
competitions.qualification: North American Zone 18 teams (MLS, Liga MX, Canadian Premier League, U.S. Open Cup, Canadian Championship, Leagues Cup places), Central American Zone 6 (via the Central American Cup), Caribbean Zone 3 (via the Caribbean Cup). Five byes to the round of 16: the champions of the three regional competitions plus the MLS Cup and Liga MX champions.

phases.label: Round one
phases.quote: Round one ... 3-4 and 17-19 February ... 10-12 and 24-26 February

competitions.quote: Twenty-seven teams qualified for the tournament, with five qualifying directly to the round of 16. The remaining 22 teams entered in round one.

competitions.name: OFC Men's Champions League
competitions.clubs_note: competition proper; 11 teams total from 11 associations
competitions.qualification: Champions (or nominated entrants) of the OFC member associations. Three teams play a single-round-robin preliminary group in Samoa (31 January - 6 February) for the last place; the other seven join the 8-team final tournament in one host country (Fiji in 2026).
competitions.quote: Competition proper: 8 / Total: 11 (teams) ... Competition proper: 9-22 August

competitions.name: AFC Challenge League
competitions.clubs_note: competition proper; 29 teams total from 18-19 associations
competitions.qualification: Third tier for associations outside the ACL Elite/Two slot lists. Entrants come from the lower-ranked AFC member associations; a preliminary stage (11 August - 15 September, regionalised) reduces the field to 20 for the group stage. The winner qualifies for the next AFC Champions League Two group stage, the runner-up for its preliminary stage.

phases.label: Preliminary stage
phases.quote: Preliminary stage ... 11-12 August 2026 (West) ... 11 August, 8 and 15 September 2026 (East)

competitions.quote: The 2026-27 AFC Challenge League is the 13th edition of the Asia's third-tier continental club football competition
